skill.name: figma-automation
skill.description: Automate authenticated Figma workflows through Rube MCP, including file inspection, component discovery, design token extraction, comments, version history, and image exports.
skill.summary: Guide Claude, Codex, or Claude Code through structured Figma workflows using Rube MCP.
skill.author: sickn33

security_audit.summary: All 49 shell-execution alerts are false positives caused by Markdown backticks around tool names, parameters, URLs, or workflow examples. The six reconnaissance alerts are also false positives. The external Rube MCP connection and authenticated Figma access create a legitimate third-party data and authorization boundary.

remediation.suggestion: Explain that Rube and Composio process Figma data, recommend least-privilege access, and require confirmation before write actions or downloads.
Link to official setup documentation and tell users to verify the MCP endpoint before entering Figma authorization credentials.

static_findings.snippet: - Active Figma connection via `RUBE_MANAGE_CONNECTIONS` with toolkit `figma`
- Always call `RUBE_SEARCH_TOOLS` first to get current tool schemas
**Get Rube MCP**: Add `https://rube.app/mcp` as an MCP server in your client configuration. No API k
1. Verify Rube MCP is available by confirming `RUBE_SEARCH_TOOLS` responds
- `file_key`: File key from URL (e.g., 'abc123XYZ' from figma.com/design/abc123XYZ/...)
- `depth`: Tree traversal depth (2 for pages and top-level children)
- `simplify`: True for AI-friendly format (70%+ size reduction)
- `ids` must be a comma-separated string, not an array
- Response data may be in `data_preview` instead of `data`
- `images`: Array of {node_id, file_name, format} for downloads
- `tokens`: Full tokens object from extraction (for Tailwind conversion)
**Get Rube MCP**: Add `https://rube.app/mcp` as an MCP server in your client configuration. No API k
2. Extract file_key, node_id, team_id from response

content.user_title: Automate Figma Workflows with Rube MCP
content.value_statement: Manual Figma inspection, export, and token extraction consume time and invite inconsistent results. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code through structured Rube MCP workflows.
actual_capabilities: Connect to Figma through Rube MCP and verify active authorization.
Discover resource identifiers from Figma URLs and retrieve file, node, component, and component-set data.
Render selected nodes as PNG, SVG, JPG, or PDF and download generated images.
Extract colors, typography, spacing, styles, and variables, with optional Tailwind conversion.
Read or add file comments, inspect versions, and browse team projects, files, and published styles.
limitations: Requires configured Rube MCP and active Figma authorization.
Uses third-party Rube and Composio infrastructure, so users should review permissions and data-handling terms.
File JSON retrieval supports Figma Design files, not FigJam boards or Figma Slides.
Large file requests can exceed payload limits, while large renders may be scaled down.

use_cases.title: Inspect Designs for Implementation
use_cases.description: Retrieve pages, nodes, and component metadata before building an interface.

use_cases.title: Extract a Design System
use_cases.description: Collect styles and variables, then prepare complete tokens for Tailwind conversion.

use_cases.title: Coordinate Design Reviews
use_cases.description: Review comments and versions, then post approved feedback to the Figma file.

prompt_templates.title: Summarize a Figma File
prompt_templates.prompt: Connect through Rube MCP and summarize the pages and top-level components in [FIGMA_URL]. Use depth 2 and report access errors.
prompt_templates.scenario: Begin with a structured overview of one design file.

prompt_templates.title: Export Selected Assets
prompt_templates.prompt: Find nodes named [NODE_NAMES] in [FIGMA_URL], render them as [FORMAT] at [SCALE], and provide the available download links.
prompt_templates.scenario: Export a known set of design assets.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare Tailwind Tokens
prompt_templates.prompt: Extract local styles and variables from [FIGMA_URL], summarize token groups, then convert the complete token response into a Tailwind configuration.
prompt_templates.scenario: Translate a Figma design system for frontend development.

prompt_templates.title: Audit Components and Feedback
prompt_templates.prompt: Review components, comments, and versions for [FIGMA_URL], identify inconsistencies, and add approved comments only after showing the proposed messages.
prompt_templates.scenario: Run a controlled design review across several Figma resources.

output_examples.input: Summarize the top-level structure of the provided Figma design file.
output: Found four pages and eighteen published components.
The main library includes buttons, form controls, navigation, and status indicators.
Two component sets contain inconsistent variant names.

output_examples.input: Extract design tokens and summarize the result before Tailwind conversion.
output: Extracted color, typography, spacing, and radius groups.
Local styles and variables were included.
The complete extraction is ready for Tailwind conversion.

output_examples.input: Export the Logo and App Icon nodes as PNG images.
output_examples.output: Rendered both nodes at the requested scale and returned two temporary download links.

best_practices: Search Rube tools before each workflow because schemas can change.
Request only required nodes and use a shallow depth before detailed traversal.
Ask for approval before posting comments or downloading assets to local storage.
anti_patterns: Do not send unreviewed comments or assume write permission.
Do not request entire deep file trees when specific node identifiers are available.
Do not reuse expired render URLs or expose them in public channels.

faq.question: What access does this skill require?
faq.answer: It requires Rube MCP, an active Figma connection, and permission to access the requested files or teams.

faq.question: Does it support FigJam boards or Figma Slides?
faq.answer: No. File JSON retrieval supports Figma Design files, while FigJam boards and Figma Slides return unsupported-file errors.

faq.question: Which image formats can it export?
faq.answer: It can render selected nodes as PNG, SVG, JPG, or PDF, subject to Figma size limits.

faq.question: Can it create Tailwind design tokens?
faq.answer: Yes. It extracts Figma styles and variables, then passes the complete token response to the Tailwind conversion tool.

faq.question: Why must it search tools first?
faq.answer: Rube tool names and schemas can change, so discovery confirms current parameters before a workflow starts.

faq.question: How should sensitive Figma data be protected?
faq.answer: Use least-privilege authorization, review Rube and Composio terms, limit requested nodes, and approve write actions before execution.
